technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic bullish cross and volume spike present potential reversal setup, but price remains below all key moving averages with bearish MACD and weak trend structure, limiting high-probability entry confidence.

fundamental.summary: LHX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 41 days present timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional selling (small amounts, junior members) lacks conviction; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (394.6) with flat yield curve and recent FOMC decision create severely unfavourable macro conditions; earnings in 41 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period), stochastic bullish cross, and 15x volume spike with contrarian extreme fear sentiment create textbook reversal setup near support at 203.81.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, weak ADX trend confirmation, three black crows pattern, zero fundamental support, high earnings risk in 41 days, and macro crisis regime (VIX 394.6) override technical oversold signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and stochastic bullish cross with 15x volume spike present technical reversal setup; contrarian fear sentiment aligns with support level at 203.81.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis regime (VIX 394.6), bearish MACD structure, price below all moving averages, and high earnings risk in 41 days create compounding headwinds that override technical oversold signals.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical reversal signals conflict sharply with fundamental weakness, macro crisis, and earnings proximity; bear case dominates despite technical setup.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 20 positions in Industrials sector; adding LHX increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart-money conviction to justify sector overweight.
